# Two Fires

> Two Fires is an embedded marketing firm in Sydney, Australia. It combines world-class brand strategy (Fire One) with an AI-powered execution engine (Fire Two) to help growing, expert businesses turn capability into clear positioning and measurable commercial growth.

## What we do

- Brand strategy and positioning: thirty years of brand work at McDonald's, Mars, Unilever and Burger King, applied to growing businesses.
- AI execution engine: an internal AI agent stack that handles research, drafting, distribution and reporting, so human judgment stays on strategy.
- AI visibility field studies: we log real AI answers (Google AI Mode and others) for a market, identify which businesses the machines recommend and which they skip, and fix the machine-readable record for clients.

## Founders

- Paul Tredinnick (Fire One, Brand): 30 years of executive marketing leadership at McDonald's, Mars, Unilever, Burger King and Primo Foods. Author of Marketing Executive's AI Authority.
- James Whitehill (Fire Two, Engine): advertising production and operational systems, leads the AI agent architecture.
